app.title: DIMS Dashboard — ORTHO (Multimodal Synchrony Exploration Visualization)
app.summary: A person picks one recorded session and sets a window length in seconds. They then click a point on the session timeline, and every view narrows to a window around that moment. Tabs show the movement and gaze signals on a shared time axis, the path the object took drawn over the board, recurrence plots with their measures, cross-wavelet coherence tested against a chance level, and the annotation tiers. Alongside, they watch the matching stretch of video from one of several camera angles and read the transcript, so each moment's synchrony measures can be checked against what happened.

task.text: Measure how several synchronised signals from a recorded interaction recur and co-vary over time, and check each moment against the video, the annotations and the transcript.

data.text: Recorded interaction sessions, each with movement time series, coded gaze intervals for each partner, annotation tiers, a transcript, a board image and videos from several cameras, plus precomputed recurrence and wavelet results
data.item: a recorded session of two partners, viewed through a time window around one chosen moment

stage.text: exploring and analysing coded multimodal recordings for interpersonal synchrony

mechanism.text: A session selector and a click on the timeline set a time window that every tab redraws for: line charts of the signals, a trajectory over the board image, recurrence and wavelet heatmaps, and annotation tiers. The video segment and the transcript beside them show the same window, so measures can be read against the recording.

field.text: recurrence quantification and cross-wavelet coherence of multimodal interaction in cognitive science

workflow.name: relate synchronised signals of a recording around chosen moments

steps.here: A Video ID dropdown, filled from the config, picks one session. Its precomputed time series, gaze codes, analyses, annotations and transcript load from the assets folder.

steps.step: choose a moment and a window of time around it
steps.here: Clicking a point on the timeline slider centres a window whose length in seconds comes from the Window Size field. All the tabs narrow to that window.

steps.step: look over the signals at that moment
steps.here: The Time series tab plots ball speed, vx and vy, and each partner's gaze code, on one time axis. The Trajectory tab draws the path so far over the board image.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: The RQA tab shows recurrence plots with recurrence rate, determinism and laminarity over time. It also shows a categorical gaze RQA for each partner. The Cross-Wavelet tab shows coherence by time and scale against a Monte Carlo null, with the share of cells above chance. These analyses are built offline by build_assets.
The matching video segment plays from the wide, parent or child camera. The ELAN tab and the transcript panel show what was annotated and said in the window.

distinctive: Gaze is a set of coded areas of interest, so its recurrence is categorical: an exact match of codes rather than a distance under a threshold. It is computed for each partner separately.
Wavelet coherence is shown with a chance level from a Monte Carlo null, together with the share of cells that beat it.
Up to three camera perspectives per session can be switched, and seeking needs a local server that supports Range requests.
Sessions with missing modalities still draw. Where logged positions are missing, the trajectory is integrated from velocity on an uncalibrated field.
